claims.head: Fresh legs against tired ones
claims.body: The Capitals played last night and get no rest before this one. Teams in that spot usually get the worse of the chances, so we expect the Lightning to control more of the play than they usually do.
claims.call: The Lightning get a bigger share of the 5-on-5 chances than they usually do.

claims.head: The Lightning’s edge in forecheck pressure
claims.body: The Lightning are near the top of the league for forecheck pressure, and the Capitals are one of the worst. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one.

TBL.head: A big edge for the Lightning
TBL.body: Tampa Bay has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage, while Washington is on the second night of a back-to-back. The Capitals’ best way in is getting good looks.
